items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Well after the show closed I'd work around there and I'd be a little work. I'd work around there maybe two or three months with him.

ctx.x: Let me see here. Did you ever work in Memphis much? Or did the shows always play there usually? Well, that was the Rabbit Foot Show headquarters. And well every year we would go to Memphis to rehearse. Start out. Three weeks rehearsal. Then we would hit the road with the show. Well when the show would close, we'd come back and close in Memphis. The show would close in Memphis. Well I would always join a little band there and hook up with a fella there called Red Davis. He was a drummer. Red Davis was a drummer…
How many years were you with the Rabbit Foot about? Well altogether I worked with the Rabbit Foot Show 14 years. 14? That's how long. I've seen a lot of other musicians come and go I guess.
